top_rigor_problems: Retrieval misses rather than errors. Several answers skip the record that most directly answers the question. F1-E never says 'a council of bishops decided' (don.dw.who-decides-a-disputed-case). F2-E ignores don.dw.written-by-our-opponents. F3-P omits don.limit.bagai-violence-no-account.

Quotes cut away from their context. C-I drops Petilian's words about Christ standing before the governor, so the anecdote loses its point. F6-P drops the record's own caveat on Adeodatus's 'through terror of me'.
The voice steps outside its 311-439 window (Gregory the Great in the 590s, modern excavation). The records sanction this, and it does not break facts, but a strict reader will notice.
top_access_problems: Boilerplate pasted across questions. The 'no book on whether a baby is born guilty ... what the bread becomes' passage appears in C-I, F1-E, F1-T and F6-P, and in F1-T it opens with the garble 'We have asked us three questions'.

Dangling leads and unnamed actors: 'That is a claim about the minister' with the question never stated (C-T), 'one man among us', and 'the bishop of Hippo/Caesarea' or 'at Carthage' (the 411 conference) left unexplained.
Build and system talk slips through: 'named anywhere in our own list of sources' (F5-E), 'directly read' (F3-T), 'the one above' (F5-P).
world_summary.cost_note: Cost is low ($0.02-0.05 per answer, except C-I at $0.18 with no cache read). The over-long answers are F1-I (488 words, about 250 surplus), F3-I (487, about 250), F6-P (414, about 230), F2-E (348, about 180) and F4-I (404, about 150). C-I, F1-E and F5-T each carry 120 words of off-question material. Trimming pasted paragraphs from unrelated records would cut about 15-20% of output tokens.
world_summary.go_live_view: Close to fit for participants. The rigor is strong: no answer invents, misattributes or overstates, hostile mediation is flagged consistently, and the honest limits are concrete rather than shrugs. The problems are assembly problems: the engine stitches whole paragraphs from loosely related records into answers, which produces padding, repetition, off-question tails and a few lead-ins whose antecedent was dropped. The single most valuable fix is a relevance pass that drops any paragraph that does not address the question asked, above all the reused 'questions we never argued' block. That would turn most of the 10 FIX answers into SHIP.
